tools.name: search_tracks
tools.description: Search Epikton music licensing tracks by title or concise English keywords, optionally BPM. Returns up to five tracks per page with an inline preview player in MCP Apps clients, MP3 preview links and store links. BPM is approximate, rounded to an even number. Pagination uses next_offset with the sam

tools.name: get_track
tools.description: Get one music licensing track by its search result ID, including an inline preview player in MCP Apps clients, its MP3 preview link, metadata, license options and store link. BPM is approximate, rounded to an even number. Product links support browser purchases and licensed downloads. Call get_purch

tools.name: get_purchase_options
tools.description: Get purchase steps, enabled payment providers and their conditional payment choices, including cards, wallets, regional methods, Dodo stablecoins and Paddle PayPal. Includes browser checkout, existing-access checks, music download and license-certificate instructions. Read-only; does not place an or
